notes: Fixed conformance corpus. Each case is a trap for a specific failure mode. Prefix kinds match Flair embeddings-provider.ts (document = stored Memory.content, query = SemanticSearch q, none = omitted inputType passthrough).

cases.trap: Short ASCII body. Traps a tokenizer that drops BOS/EOS or special-cases single-token inputs.
Same body as short-hello-document with search_query: instead of search_document:. Traps inverted nomic asymmetry (passing the prefix STRING as the inputType VALUE).
Same body unprefixed (Flair omitted-inputType passthrough). Traps a dropped or always-on prefix. Sibling for the drop-prefix must-fail control.

cases.text: 記憶レイヤ — recall must not silently collapse。stapler 📎
cases.trap: CJK + fullwidth punctuation + emoji. Traps a WordPiece impl that mishandles multibyte codepoints or strips non-ASCII.
NFC composed accents. Pair with unicode-nfd: a normalizer that folds NFC↔NFD will collide these; nomic WordPiece does not.
NFD decomposed accents of unicode-nfc. Traps unicode-normalize-before-tokenize that Flair/HFE do not apply.
Whitespace-only body under search_document:. Traps collapsing whitespace to empty or skipping the embed.
Empty body, prefixed to 'search_document: '. Traps an embedder that refuses empty input or guesses a zero vector instead of embedding the prefix tokens.

Empty unprefixed input. Traps a path that invents a vector when llama.cpp has no body tokens (HFE returns a 0-length array on tokenize-empty; the reference records whatever llama-embedding actually emits — fail closed, never guess).
